info.title: Node.js Backend API
info.description:
API Documentation for the Campaign Management & Collaboration Platform
## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT authentication via Bearer token.
## Rate Limiting
API calls are rate-limited to prevent abuse.

post.description: Creates a new user account with first name, last name, email, and password.

400.description: Validation error or Email already in use

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token.

401.description: Invalid credentials

post.description: Assigns a role (e.g., Owner, Influencer) to a registered user.

400.description: User already has this role or invalid input

post.description: Generates a new access token using a valid refresh token from cookies.

401.description: Invalid or expired refresh token

Handles the callback from Google after successful authentication.

401.description: Authentication failed

post.description: Logs out the current user session.

post.description: Generates AI campaign preview without saving to database. Returns AI-generated suggestions for review.

post.description: Saves AI preview or manual campaign as draft with lifecycleStage set to 'draft' and isPublished set to false. Accepts full campaign with all relations.

userDescription.example: A marketing campaign for our new summer clothing line focusing on Gen Z.

post.description: Creates and publishes campaign in one step. Sets lifecycleStage to 'saved' and isPublished to true. Logs CREATE_CAMPAIGN action. Accepts full campaign with all relations.

userDescription.example: A marketing campaign for our new summer clothing line focusing on Gen Z.

post.description: Creates a new campaign with 'saved' lifecycleStage and configurable publish status. Accepts full campaign with all relations. Logs the CREATE_CAMPAIGN action.

userDescription.example: A marketing campaign for our new summer clothing line focusing on Gen Z.

isPublished.description: Set to true to publish, false to save as draft (default true)
